bugFixes.zh-CN: 发布工具在公证失败时保留脱敏后的具体步骤、退出码与诊断，便于定位错误。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve the failing notarization operation, exit code and redacted diagnostics in release-tool errors.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 仅对票据服务的临时错误有限重试，签名、公证回执或附票验证失败仍阻断发布。
bugFixes.en-US: Retry transient ticket-service errors a bounded number of times while continuing to block publication on failed signature, receipt or stapling checks.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Windows 状态栏命令回归测试先解码已有 PowerShell 命令，再检查原有行为。
bugFixes.en-US: Decode the existing PowerShell command in Windows status-line regression tests before checking its behavior.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正更新日志弹窗测试对空日志节点的依赖，兼容正式候选嵌入的真实日志。
bugFixes.en-US: Make release-notes dialog tests work with both empty development logs and real notes embedded in release builds.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Windows 皮肤监视任务回归测试的模块引用，使原生 CI 能编译并执行已有断言。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct module references in Windows skin watcher regression tests so native CI can compile and execute the existing assertions.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 为 Windows 与 Unix 分别声明静态 PowerShell、Bash 步骤，消除工作流 Shell 字段的动态表达式解析错误。
bugFixes.en-US: Declare separate static PowerShell and Bash steps for Windows and Unix, eliminating dynamic shell expression parsing errors.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 按构建矩阵显式选择 PowerShell 或 Bash，修复工作流 Shell 字段使用不支持上下文而无法启动的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Select PowerShell or Bash explicitly from the build matrix so unsupported shell contexts no longer prevent workflow dispatch.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 签名凭据导入时复核批准的 Developer ID，并提供不含秘密的具体错误诊断。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Verify the approved Developer ID during signing credential import and provide specific diagnostics without exposing secrets.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Windows CI 使用原生 PowerShell 和明确的 MSVC 链接器，避免 Git Bash 同名工具抢占。
bugFixes.en-US: Use native PowerShell and an explicit MSVC linker in Windows CI to prevent collisions with Git Bash tools.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修正 Linux AMD64 的原生编译器依赖包名，保留正确 GNU 工具前缀。
bugFixes.en-US: Correct Linux AMD64 compiler package names while preserving the GNU tool prefix.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Windows CI 导入 Visual Studio 后覆盖 Node 路径的问题，并保留实际 SDK 编译环境。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve the selected Node runtime and native SDK environment after importing Visual Studio settings in Windows CI.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 接入 GitHub Actions 原生多平台发布流程，构建 Windows、macOS 公证包与 Linux AMD64/ARM64 安装包。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add native GitHub Actions release builds for Windows, notarized macOS, and Linux AMD64/ARM64 packages.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 额度行使用 5h、本周、本月短标题，以标签显示重置倒计时，并将剩余百分比放在行尾。
bugFixes.en-US: Use concise 5h, weekly and monthly quota labels, show reset countdowns as tags, and place remaining percentages at the end of each row.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 移除设备管理页的本机实例信息和配对备份恢复区块，保留已有设备配对能力。
bugFixes.en-US: Remove the local instance information and pairing backup/restore sections from device management while preserving device pairing.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 在 AI 监控中显示真实提供商额度，优先读取本机记录，支持 Codex、Claude statusLine、Cursor 月额度与 Grok。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Show verified provider quotas in AI monitoring, preferring local records and supporting Codex, Claude statusLine, Cursor monthly quotas and Grok.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 向认证终端同步提供商额度并支持主动查询，小组件可通过加密 HTTP 独立读取桌面摘要。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Sync provider quotas to authenticated terminals, support explicit queries, and let widgets fetch encrypted desktop summaries over HTTP.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 提供加密配对备份与恢复，展示稳定桌面身份并区分测试实例。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add encrypted pairing backup and recovery, expose stable desktop identity, and distinguish test instances.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 额度卡显示套餐标签、真实五小时及周／月窗口，并使用红黄绿进度条。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Show plan labels, actual five-hour and weekly/monthly windows, and red-yellow-green quota progress bars.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 设备发现服务失败后自动退避重试，并统一 Agent 显示名称。
bugFixes.en-US: Retry failed device advertising with bounded backoff and unify Agent display names.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 保留只有周额度的卡片，修复 JSONL 截尾、较新空记录及 Cursor 多行缓存导致本地窗口被丢弃的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Keep weekly-only cards and preserve local windows across truncated JSONL tails, newer empty records and multiple Cursor cache rows.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 隔离 curl 与 SQLite 的用户默认配置，拒绝外部程序失败退出，并让超时覆盖标准输入写入。
bugFixes.en-US: Ignore user curl and SQLite startup configuration, reject failed process exits, and apply timeouts to stdin writes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复小于 1% 的百分数被错误放大为比例的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix percentages below 1% being incorrectly treated as fractional ratios.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增局域网终端配对与加密连接，同步今日 Token 用量、Hooks 状态及按需图片资源。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add LAN device pairing and encrypted connections for today's token usage, Hook status and on-demand image resources.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 客户端发起配对时自动显示全局弹窗，展示名称与连接地址，四位配对码明文输入并保留前导零。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Automatically show a global dialog for incoming pairing requests, with the reported name, connection address and visible four-digit code entry preserving leading zeros.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 终端设备页采用紧凑配图卡片，按认证上报区分手机与平板，并展示 iPhone 所属 Watch 的独立通信状态。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Use compact illustrated device cards, distinguish phones and tablets from authenticated reports, and show separate communication status for an iPhone's Watch.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增共用 Rust 配对与移动协议桥，双向认证成功且私有存储完成后才确认配对。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add shared Rust pairing and mobile protocol bridges, confirming pairing only after mutual authentication and successful private storage.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 图库支持 BMP 及静态、动态 WebP，保留透明度、动画延迟与循环次数。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Support BMP and static or animated WebP images while preserving transparency, frame timing and loop counts.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 校验 WebP 内部编码帧与容器尺寸，防止畸形图片绕过解码内存预算，并保留合法动画扩展块兼容性。
bugFixes.en-US: Validate encoded WebP frame dimensions against their containers to prevent malformed images from bypassing decode memory budgets, while preserving valid animation extension chunks.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 配对请求按独立票据处理取消、断开与过期，避免旧窗口或迟到回调影响新连接。
bugFixes.en-US: Bind pairing cancellation, disconnects and expiry to individual tickets so stale dialogs and late callbacks cannot affect a new connection.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 Linux 应用目录元数据，供软件中心关联已安装应用、包身份与卸载入口。
bugFixes.en-US: Include Linux AppStream catalog metadata so software centers can associate installed applications with their packages and removal actions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 统一原生启动与 X11 窗口状态处理，减少重复的宿主协议逻辑。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Unify native startup and X11 window-state handling to reduce duplicated platform logic.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Linux 自启状态读取与注册共用用户目录解析，避免 HOME 缺失时误判。
bugFixes.en-US: Use the same home-directory resolution for Linux autostart registration and status reads, including when HOME is absent.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复本机发布登记落后导致的版本门禁阻断，并完整保留后续待发变更。
bugFixes.en-US: Recover stale local release tracking without losing subsequent pending changes or bypassing version checks.
